svg.title: MethodCheck episode workflow: the per-turn loop driving the conversation through six stages
svg.desc: An episode starts from a scenario, then loops each turn: the agent picks a skill and acts in the current stage, the stage tracker validates and advances stages including a Stage 4 content gate, the persona responds with an understanding level, until Stage 6 is reached or the student exits, then survey and reward are computed.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How is a scenario defined in scenarios.py?')

svg.text: per-turn loop (until Stage 6 or student exits, max turns cap)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the agent do each turn in agent.py?')
sendPrompt('How does the stage tracker validate and advance stages?')
sendPrompt('What is the Stage 4 content gate and why was it added?')
sendPrompt('How does the persona respond and track understanding?')
sendPrompt('What decides whether the loop continues or ends?')
sendPrompt('How is the learner survey collected in persona.py?')
sendPrompt('How is the reward calculated and blended with stage progress?')
sendPrompt('What gets written to SQLite and the JSON result file?')
g.text: SQLite log + per-run JSON (skills, stages, understanding, reward)

svg.text: Click any box to explore that part of the pipeline.
